title: Step 4a - Plotting Linear Regression Data in R: ggplot2 Step-by-Step Guide

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So now it's time for the fun part, I can't wait to show you the training set results and the test set results, So let's start to build the graphs.
cues.zh: 現在進入有趣的部分，迫不及待想展示訓練集與測試集結果，先開始建立圖表。

cues.en: So the first thing we're going to do is to import the ggplot2 library which is a very good way of plotting something in R.
cues.zh: 首先匯入 ggplot2，這是在 R 裡非常好用的繪圖函式庫。

cues.en: So I'm going to import it.
cues.zh: 現在匯入。

cues.en: But before importing this library, there might be some of you who are starting R for the first time, So if we go to our packages here, you can see that the ggplot2 library is here, on my R studio
cues.zh: 但在匯入前，剛開始用 R 的朋友要注意；我在 Packages 裡已經看得到 ggplot2，

cues.en: but it might not be the case for you because and that would mean that the ggplot2 library is not installed on your R.
cues.zh: 你的環境可能還沒有，這就代表 R 裡尚未安裝它。

cues.en: So just for those of you for which it's the case I'm going to install ggplot2 library, so we have to use this command install packages here,
cues.zh: 如果是這種情況，先用 install.packages 指令安裝 ggplot2。

cues.en: and then in parenthesis we add ggplot2, ggplot2, then we select this, press commander control
cues.zh: 括號裡用引號填 ggplot2，再選取這行，按 Command 或 Control

cues.en: plus end to execute.
cues.zh: 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here right now you can see it's installing the library and that's done.
cues.zh: 可以看到正在安裝，現在完成了。

cues.en: So that's the message you should be obtaining when you install a package.
cues.zh: 安裝套件時，應該會看到類似訊息。

cues.en: Now it should be appearing in your library, so mine is here and we are ready to start plotting the graph.
cues.zh: 現在它應該會出現在套件清單，我的在這裡，可以開始繪圖。

cues.en: I'm just going to put that in comment, So command shift plus C, now it's in common because once it's installed we don't need to install it again.
cues.zh: 把安裝這行註解掉，按 Command 或 Control 加 Shift 加 C，因為只要安裝一次。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's start to plot our training set results graph.
cues.zh: 現在畫訓練集結果。

cues.en: So, okay, so first thing we need to do is you can see the ggplot2 library is not selected here, So we will need to select it, but we want to automate all this if we want to
cues.zh: 首先，可以看到 ggplot2 沒有勾選，需要載入；但為了之後在其他資料集使用時能自動執行，

cues.en: use simple linear regression on another data set, so we will just type here library then in parenthesis the name of the library, not in quote actually, ggplot2
cues.zh: 我們直接寫 library(ggplot2)，這次名稱不用引號。

cues.en: and as you can see, if I select this line and execute here you see that it's not selected and if I execute, it's selected.
cues.zh: 目前還沒勾選，選取並執行這行後，就會載入並勾選。

cues.en: Here we just have a suggestion to type suppress package start messages to eliminate package start messages, well, that's not very important.
cues.zh: 這裡建議使用 suppressPackageStartupMessages 來隱藏啟動訊息，這不是重點。

cues.en: You can execute that if you don't want the package start messages, but that's okay.
cues.zh: 如果不想顯示訊息，可以使用它，否則也沒關係。

cues.en: So I'm just going to enlarge this.
cues.zh: 我把這裡放大。

cues.en: Okay, and now like for this course, the approach we will be taking to build this graph with ggplot2 is going to be a step by step approach because we are first going to
cues.zh: 和整門課一樣，我們會逐步建立 ggplot2 圖表，首先

cues.en: plot all the observation points in the training set, then we're going to plot the regression line, and then we're going to add a title, and then a label to the x axis and a label to the Y axis.
cues.zh: 畫出訓練集的觀測點，再畫迴歸線，接著加標題、x 軸標籤與 y 軸標籤。

cues.en: So you know it's gonna be step by step.
cues.zh: 一步一步來。

cues.en: First the observation points, then the regression line, then the title, then the labels.
cues.zh: 先觀測點，再迴歸線、標題、標籤。

cues.en: Okay, so let's start with the observation points.
cues.zh: 從觀測點開始。

cues.en: So, okay, so generally to introduce a plot in ggplot, we start by typing ggplot parenthesis.
cues.zh: 通常建立 ggplot 圖形，先寫 ggplot()。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And then that's when we start to build step by step the little components of our graph.
cues.zh: 接著逐一加入圖表的小元件。

cues.en: And since we're adding each component one by one, we are gonna separate each of these components by a plus.
cues.zh: 因為每個元件都依序加上，所以用加號分隔。

cues.en: So let's go for the first component plus here, I will press enter, and here we go for the first component.
cues.zh: 第一個元件前面加 +，再換行。

cues.en: So the first components are the observation points, so very intuitively we are going to write geom_point.
cues.zh: 第一個元件是觀測點，直覺地使用 geom_point。

cues.en: Alright? So we are going to use this function of ggplot to scatter plot all our observation points of the training set.
cues.zh: 這個 ggplot 函式可以把訓練集的全部觀測點畫成散佈圖。

cues.en: So the first thing that we need to do, is to precise which are gonna be the x axis and the Y axis.
cues.zh: 首先，要指定 x 與 y 軸。

cues.en: And that's in the aesthetic function, which we call AES, so that's the function that we'll take as input the X variables and the Y variables,
cues.zh: 在 aesthetic，也就是 aes 函式裡，傳入 x 與 y 變數。

cues.en: So the X variables is our years experience variable, that means the number of years of experience, that's what we want to have in the X axis, and the Y variable will be our salaries
cues.zh: x 是 YearsExperience，也就是工作年資，這是 x 軸要顯示的內容；y 則是薪資，

cues.en: but the real ones, not the predicting ones yet.
cues.zh: 但先用實際薪資，不是預測薪資。

cues.en: So therefore we are gonna add in parenthesis X equals and then we're gonna put all our years of experience.
cues.zh: 因此在括號中寫 x =，再取出所有工作年資。

cues.en: But be careful, we want to take the years of experience of the observations and the training set, so here we'll just have to specify training set
cues.zh: 注意，只要訓練集觀測值的年資，所以指定 training_set，

cues.en: dollar, and then years experience.
cues.zh: 後面接 $YearsExperience。

cues.en: So that means that we are taking the years experience values of the observations in the training set.
cues.zh: 代表取得訓練集觀測值的 YearsExperience。

cues.en: Okay? And now same for Y, And here we do the same only with the salaries,
cues.zh: y 也是一樣，只是改成薪資，

cues.en: which is here.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: Okay? And that plots all your observation points the real ones in the plot, okay?
cues.zh: 這樣就能把所有真實觀測點畫出來。

cues.en: So we could stop here, but we would like to add a color because we will want to make the distinction between the observation points and the regression line to, you know, make a nice plot.
cues.zh: 原本可以停在這裡，但我們想加顏色，方便區別觀測點與迴歸線，讓圖表更漂亮。

cues.en: So comma here and then I'm gonna press enter to add a new argument of geom point because this can be a little confusing.
cues.zh: 這裡加逗號、換行，再加入 geom_point 的第二個引數，這裡可能有點混淆。

cues.en: Here we have, we have a comma here and a comma here.
cues.zh: 可以看到兩個逗號，一個在這裡，一個在這裡。

cues.en: This comma here is just to separate the X and the Y in the aesthetic function, and this comma here is to separate the first argument and the second argument of the geom point function.
cues.zh: 這個逗號分隔 aes 裡的 x 與 y，另一個則分隔 geom_point 的第一與第二個引數。

cues.en: So the second argument is color, and let's pick red.
cues.zh: 第二個引數是 color，這裡選 red。

cues.en: I usually like to have my observation points in red but you know, that's just my taste.
cues.zh: 我通常喜歡把觀測點畫成紅色，純粹是個人偏好。

cues.en: If you have some other taste, you're welcome to choose your favorite color for the observation point.
cues.zh: 如果你喜歡其他顏色，可以自行選擇。

cues.en: Okay? So that's it for the geom point with this geom point part here we are plotting all the observation points of our training set.
cues.zh: 這樣 geom_point 就完成了，它會畫出訓練集全部觀測點。
